requirements.title: Proposed service and use
requirements.ask: Describe the proposed service, its intended use, and the specific configuration Acme would receive.
requirements.reading: Describe Acme's actual configuration rather than a generic offering.

requirements.title: Personal information scope
requirements.ask: Clarify whether personal information will be processed and describe the categories involved.

requirements.title: Storage and inference locations
requirements.ask: Describe separately where Acme's content is stored and where it is processed, including model inference.
requirements.reading: Acme separates storage location from processing and inference location.

requirements.title: Retention by data type
requirements.ask: State retention periods separately for source files, prompts, responses, application logs and traces.
requirements.reading: Acme wants retention broken down by data type.

requirements.title: Content-accessing subprocessors
requirements.ask: List the subprocessors that may access Acme's content.

requirements.title: Cross-border content transfers
requirements.ask: Describe whether and how Acme's content crosses borders.

requirements.title: Canadian processing requirement
requirements.ask: Clarify whether content leaves Canada during processing and ensure it is not processed outside Canada, including for inference and by any fallback provider.
requirements.reading: Canadian storage alone is insufficient; the restriction applies to processing, including fallback inference.

requirements.title: Current assurance report
requirements.ask: Provide current SOC 2 or equivalent assurance.

requirements.title: Penetration test and remediation
requirements.ask: Provide the latest penetration-test report and remediation status; note the guidance that evidence older than about six months may not work for a new customer.
requirements.reading: The six-month threshold is predicted guidance, not an explicit Acme requirement.

requirements.title: Encryption and access controls
requirements.ask: Describe encryption, identity and access management, and privileged production access controls.

requirements.title: Incident response and notification
requirements.ask: Describe the incident response process and customer notification approach.

requirements.title: Recovery objectives and evidence
requirements.ask: State the approved RTO and RPO and provide supporting evidence.

requirements.title: Models and model providers
requirements.ask: Identify the models and providers used in Acme's configuration.
requirements.reading: Identify those used for Acme, not just the supplier's general provider list.

requirements.title: Provider retention and training
requirements.ask: State whether model providers can retain or train on Acme's content.

requirements.title: Model routing and fallback
requirements.ask: Describe model routing for Acme, including whether a fallback provider is enabled.

requirements.title: AI tools and actions
requirements.ask: Describe which tools or APIs the AI can call, whether it can take external actions, and the relevant controls.

requirements.title: AI human approval boundaries
requirements.ask: Describe human oversight and which AI actions require human approval.
requirements.reading: Distinguish approval of AI actions from approval of responses for external submission.

requirements.title: Prompt injection controls
requirements.ask: Describe controls against prompt injection and untrusted documents.

requirements.title: AI evaluation and limitations
requirements.ask: Describe the AI evaluation methodology and known limitations.

requirements.title: Provenance and uncertainty
requirements.ask: Describe how outputs handle provenance, citations and uncertainty.

requirements.title: DPA technical blockers
requirements.ask: Identify the technical facts that block completion of the DPA.
requirements.reading: Identify an owner for unknown blockers rather than guessing.

requirements.title: Insurance evidence and expiry
requirements.ask: Provide insurance evidence and its expiry date.

requirements.title: Potential approval delays
requirements.ask: Identify information likely to delay approval.
requirements.reading: Identify an owner for unknown information rather than guessing.

requirements.title: External submission approval
requirements.ask: Identify which responses require human approval before external submission.
requirements.reading: This concerns responses submitted externally, distinct from approval of AI actions.

requirements.title: Production pilot vendor onboarding

requirements.reading: This is a conditional production-pilot onboarding request.
